metadata.name: ovelo_guard
metadata.description: Ovelo Guard v1: oracle-bounded recurring investing on Solana

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The keeper (or anyone when `config.keeper_authority` is `None`); pays fees only.

accounts.name: treasury_token
docs: Receives the spent funding in the devnet build (never burned).

accounts.name: fee_token
docs: Required when `config.protocol_fee_bps > 0`.

instructions.name: execute_installment_routed
docs: Mainnet build: one Jupiter `route_v2` swap per leg, keeper-only (M8). Devnet-mock build:
refused (`RoutedExecutionUnavailable`).

types.name: Asset
docs: PDA `["asset", mint]`. Only registered and enabled assets can be plan outputs.

fields.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022.

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth feed for the underlying equity (price per share).

fields.name: extensions
docs: Token-2022 extensions present at registration: bit `n` set = `ExtensionType` `n`.

fields.name: scaled_ui_amount
docs: The mint has ScaledUiAmount: one token is `multiplier` shares, applied at execution.

fields.name: mock_mint_bump
docs: Bump of `["mock_mint", mint]` in the devnet build (0 in the mainnet build).

types.name: Config
docs: PDA `["config"]`, one per program (CONTRACT-V1-SPEC §4). Fields after `bump` are the v1
additions the M6 decisions need (oracle confidence, devnet treasury, Token-2022 allow-lists);
`reserved` stays last for later versions.

fields.name: admin
docs: Squads multisig vault on mainnet; the owner's deployer on devnet.

fields.name: keeper_authority
docs: `None` = anyone can execute installments.

fields.name: allowed_funding_mints
docs: Unused slots are `Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
docs: Global ceiling for every output's slippage.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: 0 at launch.

fields.name: max_installment_amount
docs: Launch cap per installment, raw funding units.

fields.name: max_confidence_bps
docs: Maximum `conf / price`, in bps.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the token accounts that receive spent funding in the devnet build.

fields.name: allowed_freeze_authorities
docs: Accepted mint freeze authorities and Pausable authorities.

fields.name: allowed_permanent_delegates
docs: Accepted permanent delegates and confidential-transfer authorities (issuer keys).

fields.name: allowed_transfer_hook_programs
docs: Accepted Token-2022 transfer-hook programs.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Settable config values (`initialize_config`, `update_config`).

fields.name: newly_skipped
docs: Periods newly marked skipped when this period started (only on its first leg).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Funding spent on this leg (after any protocol fee).

fields.name: multiplier_fp
docs: Shares per token used for this leg, fixed point 10^12 (1.0 = 1_000_000_000_000).

types.name: Plan
docs: PDA `["plan", owner, funding_mint, nonce_le_u64]` (CONTRACT-V1-SPEC §4). Every fixed-size
field comes before `outputs`, so each has a fixed offset (keeper `memcmp` filters).

fields.name: funding_amount
docs: Per installment, raw units.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: End of the schedule: `starts_at + periods × period_seconds`.

fields.name: last_executed_period
docs: `NO_PERIOD` until the first execution.

fields.name: leg_bitmap
docs: Legs done in `in_progress_period` (multi-transaction execution).

fields.name: catch_up_window_periods
docs: Snapshot of `Config.catch_up_window_periods` at creation (the delegation terms use it).

fields.name: in_progress_period
docs: Period whose legs are in flight; `NO_PERIOD` when none.

fields.name: staging_start_balance
docs: Staging balance before the in-flight period's pull.

fields.name: returned_amount
docs: Staging balance returned to the owner.

types.name: RouteLeg
docs: One leg's Jupiter instruction for `execute_installment_routed`: its accounts are the next
`account_count` remaining accounts after the leg's `[asset, price_update]`, and `data` is the
Jupiter `route_v2` instruction data, forwarded unchanged after the program's checks.
